import pprint
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import json
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, explode
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
import pyspark.sql.utils

storage_account: str = mssparkutils.notebook.run('/utils/py_utils_get_storage_account')
path_to_orchestration_file: str = "abfss://odw-config@"+storage_account+"/Crown Dev Data Dictionaries.xlsx"
print(path_to_orchestration_file)

import pandas as pd

# =====================================================
# PARAMETERS
# =====================================================

excel_file = "abfss://odw-config@pinsstodwdevuks9h80mb.dfs.core.windows.net/CrownDevDataDictionaries.xlsx"

sheet_name = "Harmonised"

dictionary_table_name = "representation"

spark_table_name = "odw_harmonised_db.applications_representation"

# =====================================================
# COPY EXCEL FROM ADLS TO LOCAL DRIVER
# =====================================================

local_file = "file:/tmp/Crown_Dev_Data_Dictionaries.xlsx"

mssparkutils.fs.cp(
    excel_file,
    local_file,
    True
)

# =====================================================
# READ EXCEL
# =====================================================

pdf = pd.read_excel(
    "/tmp/Crown_Dev_Data_Dictionaries.xlsx",
    sheet_name=sheet_name
)

print("Excel loaded successfully")
print(pdf.columns)

# =====================================================
# GET EXCEL ATTRIBUTES
# =====================================================

excel_columns = (
    pdf[
        pdf["Table Name"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .str.strip()
        == dictionary_table_name.lower()
    ]["Attribute Name"]
    .dropna()
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
    .unique()
    .tolist()
)

# =====================================================
# GET TABLE COLUMNS
# =====================================================

table_columns = [
    c.lower()
    for c in spark.table(
        spark_table_name
    ).columns
]

# =====================================================
# COMPARE
# =====================================================

excel_set = set(excel_columns)
table_set = set(table_columns)

matched = sorted(excel_set.intersection(table_set))
missing = sorted(excel_set - table_set)
extra = sorted(table_set - excel_set)

# =====================================================
# REPORT
# =====================================================

results = []

for c in matched:
    results.append((c, "MATCHED"))

for c in missing:
    results.append((c, "MISSING_IN_TABLE"))

for c in extra:
    results.append((c, "EXTRA_IN_TABLE"))

report_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    results,
    ["column_name", "status"]
)

display(report_df)

print("\nSUMMARY")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Excel columns : {len(excel_columns)}")
print(f"Table columns : {len(table_columns)}")
print(f"Matched       : {len(matched)}")
print(f"Missing       : {len(missing)}")
print(f"Extra         : {len(extra)}")

print("\nMISSING IN TABLE")
print("=" * 50)
for c in missing:
    print(c)

print("\nEXTRA IN TABLE")
print("=" * 50)
for c in extra:
    print(c)
